'''Ergast''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]]. He discovered the technique of [[Force walk]] and was the first Sith Lord that was [[Dark Temple|buried]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of [[Ergast's holocron|his own]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], a simulacrum that was referred to as the "Servant of Ergast". In life, he wielded a purple-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ergast_as_Force_Ghost.jpg|thumb|left|Ergast as a Force Ghost]]
Lord Ergast was one of the first Sith who was buried on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and the first [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], having been alive thousands of years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Following the defeat of the Empire's forces during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] at the hands of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] fleet [[Sith exodus|fled]] from the advancing forces to a world where they could be safe from the forces of the Republic and the Jedi. In [[4980 BBY]], a scout ship from the fleet re-discovered the planet of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Subsequently, other Sith in the fleet settled down on the world and proceeded to build a new [[Kaas City|city]], which would serve as the capital of a new and restored Sith Empire. During this time, Ergast's tomb was rediscovered, and the larger [[Dark Temple]] built over it. To honor the Sith Lord, a monument was built in honor of Ergast in the new Sith capital [[Kaas City]], bearing an inscription linking modern Sith techniques of life and death manipulation and binding to Ergast.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Ergast.png|right|thumb|Ergast teaches Kallig to perform a Force-walk]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Ergast's ghost resided in his tomb within the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where he was visited by Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who desired to learn the [[Force walk]] to defeat [[Darth Thanaton]]. Under the guise as a servant of Ergast, he instructed the young Sith Inquisitor to drink a cup of poison before them, which would not kill them. In some nether realm, Ergast taught all he knew of the Force walk, including the fact that more power could be drawn from an unwilling ghost than a willing one. As soon as Kallig regained consciousness, Ergast added that he would not go with them willingly as he was absorbed by the Sith Lord. Kallig later went on to absorbing the ghosts of [[Darth Andru]], [[Kalatosh Zavros]], and [[Horak-mul]]. But drawing on their power in a confrontation with Thanaton proved too much for Kallig to handle. Ergast, no longer guised as a servant, then claimed that he had forgotten to mention that the Force walk could be damaging if more than one ghost were to be bound.<ref name="TOR" />

Kallig soon sought to find a solution to this sickness before the power became too much or the Sith ghosts threatened to drive them insane. First, on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Kallig found a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] machine that altered the Sith body to hold the four ghosts' power. But as the Inquisitor journeyed to [[Voss]], Ergast mocked Kallig for thinking that they could be silenced by some magic ritual. As Kallig undertook a dreamwalking experience, Ergast took the form of [[Urtel Moren]] and attempted to kill Kallig, but was defeated. Later, with the aid of a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] Force shaman named [[Hadrik]], using a dream rock exposed Ergast's true form so he could truly be subdued.<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]]|The Ritual|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

After Kallig defeated Thanaton and gained his seat on the [[Dark Council]], the ghosts pleaded to be freed but Kallig refused. Cursing the Dark Lord, Ergast vowed they would regain their freedom, but was cut off in mid-sentence as Kallig bound them all.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Inquisitor could choose to help them find peace if they have enough light side points or choose to set them in free.
